name: 95814 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95814 (Sacramento) has 733 nonprofit organizations. 407 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 386 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95814 (Sacramento) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
